title: (No AI) Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
author: Lauren Feiner
content:
![A photo of Donald Trump with an illustrated background.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/09/STK466_ELECTION_2024_CVirginia_E.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

President Donald Trump [promised](https://apnews.com/article/trump-artificial-intelligence-data-centers-f1ac03b73d13445400eeed8631d9d879) to put a "tremendous tax" on companies that build data centers outside of the US, even as states and cities around the country are placing restrictions on new applications to build them.

"We're not going to allow our companies to build data centers outside of our country," Trump said at a press conference Friday following his summit with China President Xi Jinping and Russia President Vladimir Putin. "They allowed that to happen with chips and everything else, and it was very destructive to our country. It's where we started going behind." title: (No AI) Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
author: Robert Hart
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/gettyimages-2305894185.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Anthropic went public on November 19th, 2026. | Photo: Getty Images

Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics's most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world's best mathematicians for decades. If verified, it would mark yet another seismic achievement for AI in mathematics and add to the [upheaval already unleashed by OpenAI's previous, often inelegant forays](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1004933/ai-math-openai-breakthrough-solution) into the field.

Alpöge's solution has yet to be verified independently. Anthropic has not commented or involved itself in Alpöge's announcement. In [a document on his website](https://alpo.ge/remark.pdf), Alpöge says he texted Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei abo …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1010051/anthropic-riemann-hypothesis-millennium-prize-problem)

title: (No AI) Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
content: Hebbia tested GPT-6 Astra for financial research. Its prerelease evaluations found gains in source coverage, citation relevance, and presentation quality.

title: (No AI) Cops Are Pushing Extremely Corny ‘Grand Theft Auto 6’ Slop

content: The blockbuster game makes no secret of its contempt for law enforcement. Real police departments using it to recruit new members and scold the public apparently didn’t get the memo.

creator: Lauren Goode, Paresh Dave
title: (No AI) Jensen Huang’s ‘Lying’ Alarmed Nvidia Board Ahead of His Resignation
dc:creator: Lauren Goode, Paresh Dave
content: Amid allegations of multiple affairs, including with a direct report and an alleged Chinese intelligence asset, sources tell WIRED the Nvidia board’s main issue was the former CEO’s “lack of candor.”
